item.title: Morgan Freeman Brings the Blues to the Symphony
item.dc:creator: Michael Lortz
item.description: A song-by-song look at Morgan Freeman's ambitious marriage of blues tradition and orchestral arrangements.

item.title: David Evans on Junior Kimbrough, R.L. Burnside and the Future of Hill Country Blues (Part Two)
item.dc:creator: Jack Austin
item.description: From the distinctive sounds of Junior Kimbrough and Robert Belfour to the commercial success, changing audiences and future of Mississippi Hill Country blues.

item.title: David Evans on the Roots and Evolution of Mississippi Hill Country Blues (Part One)
item.dc:creator: Jack Austin
item.description: A look at the genre’s distinctive sound, its roots in older musical traditions, and the musicians who helped bring Mississippi Hill Country blues to wider audiences.

item.title: BEAT Brings King Crimson’s Music Back to Life at Phoenix’s Celebrity Theatre
item.dc:creator: Rick Scuteri
item.description: Adrian Belew, Tony Levin, Steve Vai, and Terry Bozzio deliver a mind-blowing two-set performance celebrating King Crimson in a sold-out night at Celebrity Theatre.
